 Print Shreyas Iyer Punjab Kings (PBKS) have announced their list of retained and released players ahead of the IPL 2027 auction, with the franchise making six changes to its squad following the previous season. Nehal Wadhera and Lockie Ferguson are among the notable names released by the franchise. Watch Shubman Gill press conference : India's playing XI, bowling combination, Rishabh Pant & more Punjab Kings will enter the auction with INR 18.60 crore remaining in their purse and six slots to fill, including two overseas positions. Punjab Kings retained players for IPL 2027
 PBKS have retained a strong core featuring captain Shreyas Iyer, along with experienced players such as Marcus Stoinis, Marco Jansen and Yuzvendra Chahal. The franchise has also retained several young Indian players as it looks to maintain squad continuity. Punjab Kings retained players: Shreyas Iyer

 Punjab Kings released players ahead of IPL 2027 auction
 Punjab Kings have released six players ahead of the auction, with Nehal Wadhera and Australian all-rounder Mitchell Owen among the notable departures. Experienced fast bowler Lockie Ferguson has also been released. Punjab Kings released players: Nehal Wadhera
 Mitchell Owen
 Lockie Ferguson
 Pyla Avinash
 Praveen Dubey
 Vishal Nishad
 Punjab Kings remaining purse and slots for IPL 2027 auction
 PBKS will head into the auction with INR 18.60 crore remaining in their purse. The franchise has six slots available, including two overseas positions. Punjab Kings auction details: Remaining purse: INR 18.60 crore
 Total slots available: 6
 Overseas slots available: 2
 Players released: 6
 The franchise will look to make the most of its available purse to address squad requirements and strengthen its options ahead of the new season. Note: The purse and squad figures are subject to change until the trade window closes on December 9, a week before the IPL 2027 auction scheduled for December 16.
